北京.name: 北京
北京.ai_briefing_zh: 北京很冷，风力大，体感 -10℃，记得穿最厚的衣服哦！
北京.ai_briefing_en: Beijing is super cold with strong winds. Bundle up warmly!
北京.alert: 📉 红色降温预警：1小时骤降10℃ | 💨 北风警报：北风 4级

慈溪.name: 慈溪
慈溪.ai_briefing_zh: 慈溪阴天，气温 14℃ 体感舒适。出门记得带伞哦！
慈溪.ai_briefing_en: Cixi is overcast and mild at 14℃. Don't forget your umbrella!

上海.name: 上海
上海.ai_briefing_zh: 上海有雾，能见度低，体感 11℃。出行注意安全，戴好口罩！
上海.ai_briefing_en: Shanghai is foggy with low visibility. Stay safe and wear a mask!

广州.name: 广州
广州.ai_briefing_zh: 广州雾气蒙蒙，体感 19℃，空气湿润。出门戴好口罩哦！
广州.ai_briefing_en: Guangzhou is foggy and warm at 19℃. Wear a mask when heading out!

深圳.name: 深圳
深圳.ai_briefing_zh: 深圳有雾，气温 20℃，体感暖和。开车注意安全，小心慢行！
深圳.ai_briefing_en: Shenzhen is foggy and warm at 20℃. Drive carefully and slowly!

杭州.name: 杭州
杭州.ai_briefing_zh: 杭州雾气浓郁，体感 8℃。出行多注意安全，注意保暖！
杭州.ai_briefing_en: Hangzhou is very foggy and a bit chilly. Stay safe and keep warm!

南京.name: 南京
南京.ai_briefing_zh: 南京阴天，体感 10℃。早晚温差大，记得添衣哦！
南京.ai_briefing_en: Nanjing is cloudy and feels like 10℃. Mind the temperature change, layer up!

成都.name: 成都
成都.ai_briefing_zh: 成都天晴，体感 6℃，空气湿润。早晚凉，记得保暖别着凉！
成都.ai_briefing_en: Chengdu is clear and 6℃. It's chilly, so keep warm and don't catch a cold!

武汉.name: 武汉
武汉.ai_briefing_zh: 武汉有雾，体感 8℃ 湿度高。出行注意安全，做好防护！
武汉.ai_briefing_en: Wuhan is foggy and 8℃ with high humidity. Drive safe and protect yourself!

西安.name: 西安
西安.ai_briefing_zh: 西安阴天，体感 4℃ 有点凉。记得多穿衣，注意保暖哦！
西安.ai_briefing_en: Xi'an is cloudy and a bit chilly at 4℃. Dress warmly and stay cozy!

重庆.name: 重庆
重庆.ai_briefing_zh: 重庆有雾，体感 8℃ 较凉。出行小心，注意交通安全！
重庆.ai_briefing_en: Chongqing is foggy and chilly at 8℃. Be careful and mind traffic safety!

哈尔滨.name: 哈尔滨
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_zh: 哈尔滨下雪啦！体感 -17℃，风大。务必多穿，小心路滑！
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_en: Harbin is snowing! It's extremely cold at -17℃. Dress warmly and watch for ice!
哈尔滨.alert: ❄️ 橙色寒冷提示：体感低至 -17℃

沈阳.name: 沈阳
沈阳.ai_briefing_zh: 沈阳天晴，但体感 -14℃ 风大！出门务必全副武装防寒！
沈阳.ai_briefing_en: Shenyang is clear but feels like -14℃ with strong winds! Bundle up well!
沈阳.alert: 📉 红色降温预警：1小时骤降5℃

昆明.name: 昆明
昆明.ai_briefing_zh: 昆明多云，体感 10℃ 比较舒适。早晚凉，别忘了添件外套！
昆明.ai_briefing_en: Kunming is partly cloudy and mild at 10℃. Grab a jacket for mornings/evenings!

厦门.name: 厦门
厦门.ai_briefing_zh: 厦门有雾，气温 17℃。小心驾驶，注意能见度降低哦！
厦门.ai_briefing_en: Xiamen is foggy and 17℃. Drive carefully due to low visibility!

青岛.name: 青岛
青岛.ai_briefing_zh: 青岛有霾，体感 3℃ 较凉。出门记得戴口罩，注意保暖！
青岛.ai_briefing_en: Qingdao is hazy and chilly at 3℃. Wear a mask and keep warm!

大连.name: 大连
大连.ai_briefing_zh: 大连很冷，风力 5级，体感 -10℃。务必穿厚衣戴帽子！
大连.ai_briefing_en: Dalian is very cold and windy at -10℃. Dress warmly and wear a hat!
